correctness.rationale: Avoidance is independence in the graph where x+y=1 or xy=1, deleting loops at 1/2 and ±1. On nonunits x∈m\{0}, the involution x→−x/(1−x), free for p≥5, pairs with 1−x and its inverse to form exactly (M−1)/2 induced P4s. Remaining units are acted on by s(x)=1−x and t(x)=x^{-1}, satisfying s²=t²=(st)³=1, hence generic orbits are induced C6. The only exceptional unit roots of x²−x+1 occur exactly twice if q≡1 mod3 and simple-root lift uniquely from the residue field because derivative 2x−1 is a unit. The 0/1 and 2/−1/1/2 components each give 1+z. Vertex partition yields the proposed polynomial, top degree (N−1)/2, leading coefficient, and total sets. Independently constructed forbidden graphs using literal operations in Z/25 and F5[ε]/ε²; their full component polynomials agree, 36 maximal sets and 82,944 total. This corroborates, not proves, all local rings.

originality.rationale: Tang 2026 Theorem2.2 / Remark2.4 analyzes only prime-field finite sum/product target avoidance with two exceptional components and unit six-cycles, deriving a prime-field extremal size. That special case and classical anharmonic action receive no originality credit. Extending to all finite commutative local rings with nilpotent maximal ideal introduces new P4 components and a nontrivial size-by-size independence polynomial invariant across nonisomorphic rings; the full local-ring enumerator is not entailed by prime-field conclusions.

value.rationale: The exact distribution of every avoiding-set cardinality over arbitrary finite local rings is a natural robust strengthening of an extremal combinatorial number-theory problem. Dependence only on (N,q) is structurally unexpected for nonisomorphic zero-divisor rings; the P4 component decomposition motivates and explains it. Both maximum count and full polynomial may be useful for enumerations and stability questions; not merely a relabelled prime-field case.

final_claim: For every finite commutative local ring with residue characteristic p≥5, the full cardinality polynomial of subsets avoiding target 1 in both A+A and AA factors into two exceptional (1+z) factors, (M−1)/2 P4 factors, δ/2 root-edge factors and (N−2M−3−δ)/6 six-cycle factors, giving max (N−1)/2 and exact count of optimizers.
limitations: p≥5, finite commutative local unital rings and target 1 only; does not cover characteristic two/three, arbitrary target, nonlocal/noncommutative rings.
All-cardinality polynomial is proved symbolically by component structure, not extrapolated from finite rings.
Prime-field case and its six-cycle mechanism are known and excluded from originality credit.
